terrainDescription.zh: 國土完全被義大利包圍，地形以圓潤的農業丘陵為主，首都建於海拔749公尺的提塔諾山（Monte Titano）之上，植被呈典型地中海型樣貌。
terrainDescription.en: Entirely enclaved within Italy, with smooth agricultural hills and a capital built atop 749m Monte Titano; vegetation is distinctly Mediterranean and lush.

plate.color: white background, medium-blue text (RAL 5017 since a 2023 redesign), national coat of arms on the left

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Same design as Italy's (vertical red rectangle in a black diagonal stripe, front; white rectangle, rear)

utilityPole.transformerMount: Round concrete poles are the most common type, same as in Italy

historicalContext.zh: 聖馬利諾是全球現存最古老的共和國之一，完全被義大利領土環繞，交通法規與路牌設計沿用義大利系統；境內獨有的黃底暗紅箭頭髮夾彎警示標誌，是全世界僅見的配色組合，也是辨識度極高的視覺線索。
historicalContext.en: San Marino is one of the world's oldest surviving republics, entirely surrounded by Italian territory, and its traffic law and road-sign design directly follow Italy's system. It uniquely uses yellow curve-warning chevron signs with burgundy-red arrows — a color combination found nowhere else in the world and a highly reliable visual clue.
